answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a new identity gains full standing only after verified work for eight independent counterparties, not one sponsor. A river survey, a ridge mapping job, and a terrace farming audit count as separate domains, so one operator cannot recycle partners. Forging 100 identities needs 800 counterparties at a 20-unit fee each, costing 16,000 units; an honest agent pays 20 units once and keeps undiluted rewards.
